id: \bWe run a Charcoal buisness here that gets exported as far as Kanto.
en: \bWe run a Charcoal buisness here that gets exported as far as Kanto.
it: \bQui gestiamo un'attività di Carbonella che esporta fino a Kanto.

id: \bHere. Have a sample.
en: \bHere. Have a sample.
it: \bEcco. Prendi un campione.

id: \bBe sure to tell your friends about us.
en: \bBe sure to tell your friends about us.
it: \bMi raccomando, parla di noi ai tuoi amici.

id: \bKurt: I heard from Professor Oak that you would be coming to give me something.
en: \bKurt: I heard from Professor Oak that you would be coming to give me something.
it: \bKurt: Il Professor Oak mi ha detto che saresti venuto a portarmi qualcosa.

id: \bYou have the GS Ball?
en: \bYou have the GS Ball?
it: \bHai la GS Ball?

id: \bI'll get to work on it right away.
en: \bI'll get to work on it right away.
it: \bMi ci metto subito al lavoro.

id: \bHere. Take these as thanks for making such a long journey.
en: \bHere. Take these as thanks for making such a long journey.
it: \bEcco. Prendi queste come ringraziamento per aver fatto un viaggio così lungo.

id: \bThose are special balls that I make. Bring some Apricorns by and I'll gladly make you more.
en: \bThose are special balls that I make. Bring some Apricorns by and I'll gladly make you more.
it: \bSono Ball speciali che creo io. Portami qualche Ghicocca e te ne farò volentieri altre.

id: \bWhat? You don't? Well stop wasting my time and go get it.
en: \bWhat? You don't? Well stop wasting my time and go get it.
it: \bCosa? Non ce l'hai? Allora smettila di farmi perdere tempo e vai a prenderla.

id: \bHello again.
en: \bHello again.
it: \bBentornato.

id: \bDo you have an Apricorn for me?
en: \bDo you have an Apricorn for me?
it: \bHai una Ghicocca per me?

id: \bWhich Apricorn would you like me to convert?
en: \bWhich Apricorn would you like me to convert?
it: \bQuale Ghicocca vuoi che trasformi?

id: \bLet me know when you want me to convert an Apricorn for you.
en: \bLet me know when you want me to convert an Apricorn for you.
it: \bFammi sapere quando vuoi che ti trasformi una Ghicocca.

id: \bOkay. I'll turn your \v[3] into a Poké Ball for you.
en: \bOkay. I'll turn your \v[3] into a Poké Ball for you.
it: \bD'accordo. Trasformerò la tua \v[3] in una Poké Ball.

id: \bI should be finished by tomorrow.
en: \bI should be finished by tomorrow.
it: \bDovrei finire entro domani.

id: \bCome back when you have an Apricorn for me.
en: \bCome back when you have an Apricorn for me.
it: \bTorna quando avrai una Ghicocca per me.

id: \bI've been waiting for you. I've completed the Poké Ball you asked me to make.
en: \bI've been waiting for you. I've completed the Poké Ball you asked me to make.
it: \bTi stavo aspettando. Ho finito la Poké Ball che mi hai chiesto.

id: \bYou have no room left. Make room, then come see me.
en: \bYou have no room left. Make room, then come see me.
it: \bNon hai più spazio. Fai spazio, poi torna da me.

id: \bI tried making a Poké Ball out of what you gave me, but it didn't work.
en: \bI tried making a Poké Ball out of what you gave me, but it didn't work.
it: \bHo provato a fare una Poké Ball con quello che mi hai dato, ma non ha funzionato.

id: \bSorry.
en: \bSorry.
it: \bMi dispiace.

id: \bI'm still working on your Apricorn. Come back later.
en: \bI'm still working on your Apricorn. Come back later.
it: \bSto ancora lavorando alla tua Ghicocca. Torna più tardi.

id: It's the GS Ball.
en: It's the GS Ball.
it: È la GS Ball.

id: \rMy grandpa is the best Poké Ball maker in the world!
en: \rMy grandpa is the best Poké Ball maker in the world!
it: \rMio nonno è il miglior creatore di Poké Ball del mondo!

id: Yes
en: Yes
it: Sì

id: No
en: No
it: No
